sullengard_godrey_0.m: Hello. I'm Godfrey, and I own this place, but I'm forced to work today because somebody quit on me.

sullengard_godrey_10.m: What can I help you with?
r: I need somewhere to relax and refresh. Do you have a bed available?
I'm hungry. Do you have any food to sell?
Do you know by chance where this lost travelor is?

sullengard_godrey_10a.m: Sure. Look at the table over there. He is my best customer at the moment.

sullengard_godrey_30.m: Well, it will cost you 700 gold! Beds are always in high demand before and during the Beer Festival.
r: That's too expensive. Let's talk about something else.
I'll take it, but I have to say that you really should join the Thieves' Guild with that attitude!

sullengard_godrey_40.m: Thank you! It pays to be the owner. You can use any available bed.

sullengard_godrey_celdar.m: Now there's a name I haven't heard in a long time. I don't think she's been in town for a long time.

sullengard_godrey_sell.m: Certainly. Please take a look at what I can offer.

mg_restless_grave.10: I noticed that one of the Galmore grave plots looked to have been dug-up in the not-so-distant past. I should ask Vaelric about this.
mg_restless_grave.15: I noticed that one of the Galmore grave plots looked to have been dug-up in the not-so-distant past.
mg_restless_grave.20: After I mentioned to Vaelric that the graveyard near the Galmore encampment has a dug-up grave plot, he asked me to investigate it. I agreed to look for clues.
mg_restless_grave.30: Just outside of the graveyard, I found a bell attached to a broken rope. It was partially buried and covered by grass, but I retrieved it.
mg_restless_grave.40: I discovered a music box in the graveyard. It was partially buried and obscured by overgrown grass.
mg_restless_grave.45: I discovered the skeletal remains of a human beneath a covering of grass and weeds. I wonder if it's related to why that grave plot is dug up?
mg_restless_grave.50: I brought the bell and music box to the Galmore encampment and encountered a ghost named Eryndor that told me the items were his. I gave them to him in exchange for being "friends".
mg_restless_grave.60: Eryndor told me his story and said he would leave Vaelric alone if I returned his ring. I should return to Vaelric.
mg_restless_grave.63: Vaelric has told me his side of the story. He claimed that Eryndor came to him desperate, in a severe condition and Vaeltic said he did everything he could to save Eryndor's life. Thinking that Eryndor was dead, Vaelric buried him.
mg_restless_grave.65: After hearing Eryndor's story, I decided that he has been wronged. I also agreed to get his ring back from Vaelric.
mg_restless_grave.70: I informed Vaelric of the ghost's terms, and he agreed. He also gave me Eryndor's ring and now I should return it to Eryndor.
mg_restless_grave.77: I've stolen the ring from Vaelric's attic.
mg_restless_grave.80: I lied to Vaelric as I informed him that I was not able to find any clues surrounding the grave site or anywhere else.
mg_restless_grave.85: I brought the ring back to Eryndor. Vaelric received no relief from the haunting.
mg_restless_grave.90: I brought the ring back to Eryndor and he agreed to stop haunting Vaelric.
mg_restless_grave.95: Vaelric rewarded me by offering to make Insectbane Tonics if I bring him the right ingredients.
mg_restless_grave.97: I need to bring Vaelric the following ingredients in order for him to make his "Insectbane Tonic": five Duskbloom flowers, five Mosquito proboscises, ten bottles of swamp water and one sample of Mudfiend goo.
mg_restless_grave.100: I brought the ring back to Eryndor just to tell him that I've decided to keep it.
mg_restless_grave.110: When I refused to return the ring, Eryndor attacked me.
mg_restless_grave.111: I defeated Eryndor and prevented the hauntings of Vaelric...for now, but I feel that they will resume someday.
mg_restless_grave.115: Vaelric is now able to mix up some Insectbane tonic for me.
mg_restless_grave.120: I've informed Vaelric that I defeated Eryndor but was not able to promise an end to the hauntings, Vaelric was dissatisfied with me and the outcome even going as far as saying that Andor is a better person than I am.
mg_restless_grave.123: Eryndor has asked me to find Celdar, a woman from Sullengard and give her the mysterious music box because he has no need for it and it's the right thing to do. I think I remember hearing that name, "Celdar" somewhere. Eryndor stated that Celdar is intolerant of fools and petty trades and wears a garish purple dress.
mg_restless_grave.125: In Sullengard, Maddalena informed me that Celdar was headed for Brimhaven, but may have stopped to rest along the way as it is a long trip to Brimhaven.
mg_restless_grave.130: I gave Celdar the 'Mysterious music box' just as Eryndor had instructed and she gave me her longsword.
